method: Built-in image generation; background initial generation followed by style refinement; four separate transparent character generations.
references: User-supplied Figma screenshots informed mood and composition only. No screenshot pixels were included in the final assets.

prompts.background_initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production web card-game landscape background, no interface. Create an original polished soft 2.5D storybook forest at dusk, warm cream, muted mint foliage, caramel wood and a gentle peach-lavender sky. A small wooden footbridge over a quiet stream and softly glowing lanterns frame the scene near the sides, rounded trees and distant tiny cozy woodland cottages. Sophisticated cute tabletop-game world, velvety sculpted forms, gentle rim light, subtle painterly texture, calm and welcoming rather than noisy. Wide landscape composition about 3:2. Middle 60 percent is an open softly lit misty clearing with low detail and generous negative space to hold game UI; most buildings, branches and lantern detail at far left/right, horizon upper third. No characters, no cards, no signs, no text, no logos, no buttons, no UI, no watermark. The artwork must feel intentionally art-directed, not clip art.
prompts.background_refinement: Edit this landscape into a cute premium 2.5D toy-like woodland board-game world. Keep the wide quiet central clearing, wooden bridge, side lanterns and dusk setting, but drastically simplify detail: chunky rounded sculpted trees, soft pillowy foliage, smooth rounded little cottages, warm caramel wood, cream and muted mint surfaces, peach-lavender sky. More like an adorable miniature clay diorama for a cozy animal card game, NOT realistic fantasy concept art. Soft matte materials, clean larger shapes, low contrast, no realistic bark/grass textures or dramatic mountains. The center must remain very calm and spacious for UI. No text, logos, signs, UI or characters. Preserve wide landscape composition.
prompts.rabbit: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game character portrait cutout for a cozy woodland card game. Polished premium soft 2.5D clay-toy style, rounded sculpted forms, creamy matte material, gently glossy dark brown bead eyes, tiny smile and rosy cheeks, soft warm front-left light, subtle dimensional shading, charming but calm not exaggerated. Centered symmetric front-facing head and upper torso, entire head/ears/paws fully visible with generous padding all around, square composition safe inside a circular avatar crop. Tiny muted mint neckerchief, two small paws at lower chest. One character only, no frame, no circle, no tabletop, no cards, no text, no symbols, no watermark, no scene. Truly transparent background. Character: an ivory bunny with two short rounded upright ears, peach-pink inner ears, a small warm brown nose, warm cream body.
